result.summary: 本文提出“柏拉图表示假说”，认为不同神经网络（尤其是深度网络）对数据的表示正在趋同，并可能收敛到对现实世界（Z）的共同统计模型 [abstract][S1.p2][S1.p4]。作者综述了文献中跨架构、跨目标、跨模态以及与人脑对齐的趋同证据，并用78个视觉模型和多个语言模型测量表示对齐，发现模型能力越强、规模越大，表示越对齐 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS3.p5]。作者提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种机制来解释趋同，并在理想化世界下证明一类对比学习器会收敛到点互信息核 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2][S4.SS2.p6]。作者还讨论了趋同对跨模态训练、翻译适应、幻觉与偏见的潜在含义，并明确列出多种反例与局限 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要探讨的问题是：不同神经网络模型的表示是否正在趋同，这种趋同由什么驱动，最终会收敛到什么表示 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者指出，AI系统在架构和能力上正变得越来越同质化，因此研究表示趋同是理解这一趋势的一个方面 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。其核心假说是存在一个趋同终点，即不同模型都在试图得到对现实（生成观测数据的联合分布）的表示 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: In short, AI systems are becoming increasingly homogeneous in both their architectures and their capabilities.
This paper explores one aspect of this trend: representational convergence.
We argue that there is a growing similarity in how datapoints are represented in different neural network models.
What has led to this convergence? Will it continue? And ultimately, where does it end?
different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe.

method.text: 论文将表示定义为向量嵌入函数，并用其诱导的核（相似性结构）来刻画表示，用核对齐度量衡量两个表示的相似性 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。实验主要采用互最近邻度量，即两个核诱导的k近邻集合的平均交集除以k [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。跨模态对齐时，作者用成对数据集（如Wikipedia图像-标题数据）作为桥梁，分别计算图像核和文本核再测量对齐 [S2.SS3.p5]。理论上，作者在理想化世界模型下分析对比学习器，证明其最优解对应点互信息核 [S4.SS2.p2][S4.SS2.p4]。

evidence.quote: We restrict our attention to representations that are vector embeddings.
We characterize such a representation by the similarity structure it induces, referred to as its kernel.
we define representational alignment as a measure of the similarity of the similarity structures induced by two representations
we use a mutual nearest-neighbor metric that measures the mean intersection of the $k$ -nearest neighbor sets induced by two kernels
To measure cross-modal alignment, we use paired datasets to bridge the two modalities.
Our contrastive learner tries to classify if a pair is positive or negative by learning a representation
the contrastive learners we consider are minimized by a representation $f_{X}$ whose kernel is $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$

experiments.text: 视觉-视觉对齐实验中，作者评估了78个视觉模型，包括不同规模的ViT、ResNet-50和ResNet-18，训练目标涵盖分类、MAE、DINO、CLIP和对比学习等 [A3.SS1.p1]。表示质量用VTAB的19个分类任务线性探测评估，对齐度量在Places-365验证集上取k=10、1000个图像表示计算 [A3.SS1.p2][A3.SS1.p3]。跨模态实验中，作者比较视觉模型与BLOOM、OpenLLaMA、LLaMA等语言模型，并在图4中加入OLMo、LLaMA3、Gemma、Mistral/Mixtral [A3.SS2.p1]。跨模态对齐在WIT数据集上取k=10、1024个样本计算，并对特征做L2归一化和截断 [A3.SS2.p3]。此外，作者还用颜色共现实验和DCI标题密度实验验证趋同 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p3]。

evidence.quote: We consider 78 vision models in total:
we evaluate linear probing performance on all 19 VTAB classification tasks
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over $1000$ image representations computed on Places-365’s validation dataset
The language model families we consider are BLOOM, OpenLLaMA, and LLaMA.
For Figure 4, we included more recent model families such as OLMo, LLaMA3, Gemma, and Mistral/Mixtral.
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over 1024 samples from WIT
We conduct a case study to verify that convergence does happen on real data.
the more descriptive (higher information) a caption is, the better its LLM representation aligns with the visual representation of the corresponding image.

findings.text: 视觉模型中，迁移性能高的模型形成紧密聚集的表示，而弱性能模型的表示更分散，表明有能力的模型以相似方式表示数据 [S2.SS2.p2]。跨模态上，语言模型的语言建模能力越强，越倾向于与视觉模型对齐，反之亦然 [S2.SS3.p5]。对齐还与下游性能相关：与DINOv2对齐更好的LLM在Hellaswag和GSM8K上表现更好 [S2.SS5.p1]。理论上，在理想化世界下，对比学习器会收敛到点互信息核，且不同模态共享同一核，从而收敛到对P(Z)的表示 [S4.SS2.p6]。颜色共现实验也显示，从图像或语言共现统计学习到的颜色表示大致恢复相同的感知表示 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: models with high transfer performance form a tightly clustered set of representations, while models with weak performance have more variable representations.
the better an LLM is at language modeling, the more it tends to aligns with vision models
The converse effect also holds: the better a vision models is, the more it tends to align with LLMs.
Figure 4 supports this hypothesis by demonstrating improved performance on commonsense reasoning (Hellaswag;) and mathematical problem solving (GSM8K;) as alignment improves.
for any modality in our idealized world, we observe representational convergence to the same kernel, which represents certain pairwise statistics of $\mathbb{P}(\mathbf{Z})$.
learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation.

limitations.text: 作者承认，不同模态可能包含不同信息，两个模型若访问根本不同的信息就无法收敛到相同表示；其数学论证仅严格适用于Z的双射投影，不适用于有损或随机观测 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。目前并非所有表示都在趋同，例如机器人领域尚无标准化的世界状态表示方式 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。AI社区的研究者偏见和“硬件彩票”可能人为导致趋同 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。专用智能可能不会趋同，论文论证只适用于被优化以完成许多任务的智能 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1]。对齐度量本身存在争议，作者只重点使用互最近邻并引用其他度量 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]。此外，对齐分数仅达到0.16（理论最大为1），这是强对齐加噪声还是存在重大差异尚属开放问题 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。

evidence.quote: Two different models cannot converge to the same representation if they have access to fundamentally different information.
our mathematical argument in Section 4 only strictly holds for bijective projections of $\mathbf{Z}$
This will not hold true for either lossy or stochastic observation functions.
we have yet to see the same level of convergence across all domains.
Researcher bias and collective preferences within the AI community have shaped the trajectory of model development.
Our argument only holds for intelligences that are optimized to perform well on many tasks.
there is active debate on the merits and deficiencies of all these ways of measuring alignment.
alignment clearly increases but only reaches a score of $0.16$, according to our mutual nearest-neighbor metric.
We leave this as an open question.
